name: Shenzhen SEG Co.,Ltd
summary: Shenzhen SEG Co.,Ltd engages in the operation and management of electronic markets, property management and urban services, new energy, inspection and testing, and real estate development businesses in China. It is also involved in cadmium telluride photovoltaic glass manufacturing; power station installation; construction, operation, and distribution of photovoltaics, and energy storage; building-integrated photovoltaics (BIPV) solutions; intelligent photovoltaic-storage-charging systems; integrated energy management for low-carbon industrial parks; and photovoltaic power station project construction and distribution, as well as photovoltaic power plant operation and maintenance.
